integrity.method: Reproducible acyclic face-poset matching, signed integral Morse boundary, and full independent mod-two simplicial reduction.

scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary nonequivariant homotopy type for the unique twelve-vertex icosahedral graph is established.
No assertion is made for larger triangulations, arbitrary polyhedral graphs or higher independence parameters.
Publication priority is based on inspected accessible evidence, not guaranteed against unindexed equivalent work.
title: The icosahedral second independence complex is a wedge of 20 three-spheres
